lessons.title: JDK, Compilation, and Program Structure
lessons.summary: Set up a Java development workflow and understand source files, classes, the main method, compilation, bytecode, and actionable compiler diagnostics.
objectives: Explain and apply the Java behavior taught in JDK, Compilation, and Program Structure
Compile, run, and test the behavior with observable evidence

blocks.heading: Core model
blocks.bodyMarkdown: The JDK provides the compiler and runtime tools. `javac Main.java` checks source and emits bytecode in `Main.class`; `java Main` starts the JVM and invokes `public static void main(String[] args)`. A public class name must match its source filename. Java is statically typed, so many invalid operations are rejected before execution. Read the first relevant compiler diagnostic, correct one cause at a time, and recompile. Packages organize names and should match directory structure in normal projects. Do not edit generated `.class` files or commit them as source.

blocks.heading: Core model
blocks.bodyMarkdown: Java primitive types store numeric, boolean, and character values; reference types such as `String` refer to objects. Choose `int` or `long` according to range and `double` for approximate decimal calculations, not exact currency. Integer division discards the fractional part when both operands are integers. `Scanner` token methods and `nextLine` interact with line endings, so design input consistently. Use `.equals` for String value comparison; `==` compares primitive values but reference identity for objects. Parse text with methods such as `Integer.parseInt` and handle invalid input explicitly.

objectives: Explain and apply the Java behavior taught in Conditions, Boolean Logic, and Boundaries

blocks.heading: Core model
blocks.bodyMarkdown: `if`, `else if`, and `else` select one path according to boolean conditions. `&&` and `||` short-circuit, which can protect later operations from invalid state. Use parentheses when operator precedence is not immediately clear. Compare strings and value objects with `.equals`, using a constant on the left when null is possible. Modern switch expressions work well for finite categories and require intentional exhaustiveness. Test values below, at, and above every threshold; `score >= 60` includes 60 while `score > 60` does not.

lessons.title: Loops, Arrays, and Iteration

blocks.heading: Core model
blocks.bodyMarkdown: Arrays have a fixed length and zero-based indexes. Use an enhanced `for` loop when only values matter and an indexed loop when positions are part of the algorithm. `while` suits state-dependent repetition but every normal path must progress toward termination. Initialize accumulators before the loop and update once per accepted item. Array access outside `0` through `length - 1` throws `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException`. Use `break` for a deliberate early exit and `continue` sparingly; required state updates must not be skipped.

blocks.heading: Core model
blocks.bodyMarkdown: Methods package behavior behind typed parameters and a return type. `void` means no result is returned. Java passes arguments by value; for object references, the copied reference still points to the same mutable object. A class combines state and behavior. Keep fields private, validate constructor and method inputs, and expose operations that preserve invariants rather than public mutable fields. `static` members belong to the class; instance members require an object. Use exceptions such as `IllegalArgumentException` when a caller violates a documented precondition.

blocks.heading: Core model
blocks.bodyMarkdown: Use `List` for ordered values, `Set` for uniqueness and membership, and `Map` for key-value relationships. Generic arguments such as `List<String>` preserve element types without casts. Choose an implementation according to behavior: `ArrayList`, `HashSet`, and `HashMap` are common defaults. A missing map key returns null from `get`, so distinguish absence with `containsKey` or use an intentional default. Do not structurally modify a collection during enhanced iteration. Return defensive copies or unmodifiable views when callers must not mutate internal state.
